summary: Susanna Deforest, 20, of Pennsylvania, died of HAPE and HACE (per Pitkin County coroner) while hiking the Conundrum Creek Trail toward Conundrum Hot Springs; she became ill and began vomiting, friends pitched a tent and two descended to alert authorities at ~10:45 p.m.; strong winds prevented a helicopter landing and a second helicopter reached her ~3:30 a.m. after she had died.
location: Conundrum Creek Trail (toward Conundrum Hot Springs), Maroon Bells-Snowmass Wilderness
responding_agency: Mountain Rescue Aspen; Pitkin County Sheriff's Office
notes: Pitkin County coroner confirmed HAPE and HACE as cause (Backpacker/Colorado Independent corroboration of the Aug-17 date); hiker became ill on the evening of 2017-08-17 and died overnight; rescuers reached her ~3:30 a.m. Aug 18.
